comment: Seepage attaches only to real liquid containers — vessels with liquidContainerProps.capacityLitres. In vanilla clay that is exactly the fired bowl (1 L) and the fired jug (3 L). The clay pot is a BlockCookingContainer and holds ingredients, not litres, and the watering can measures watering-seconds rather than litres, so neither can seep; the can is gated a different way in Parcel 2.

The class swap is what guarantees the settle actually runs — see BlockSeepingContainer. classByType already exists on the bowl with a '*-fired' key, so replacing that one value keeps every other variant untouched.
The jug declares a plain 'class' rather than classByType, and every jug variant is fired ware, so replacing it outright is correct.
